newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end up,spot Sept rises by limit.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end up,spot Sept rises by limit.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed sharply higher on Wednesday, with the spot September up by its daily 400 yen limit, as the yen's fall against the dollar triggered active buying, local traders said.
Other months were 300 to 330 yen higher, with the July 1998 contract up 330 yen at 13,780 yen per tonne. Estimated volume was 63,388 lots.
Active buying from local investors, who were encouraged by the yen's fall and price gains at the CBOT market on Tuesday, emerged throughout the day, traders said.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.69-1/2 per bushel at 0815 GMT, against $2.70-3/4 at Tuesday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean was traded at $8.08 per bushel at 0815 GMT, down from $8.11 at Tuesday's close.
